entries.title: Voice input
entries.body: Ask questions hands-free - click the microphone button in the composer or press Ctrl+Shift+V to start speaking. Transcribed text appears live as you speak.

entries.title: Read aloud
entries.body: Click the speaker icon on any response to have it read aloud using your device's text-to-speech engine. Adjust playback speed (0.75×–1.5×) in Settings → Appearance.

entries.title: Excel export
entries.body: Download query results as a formatted .xlsx file directly from any data table. Auto-sized columns and proper data types - ready to open in Excel or Google Sheets.

entries.title: Share conversation link
entries.body: Copy a direct link to the current chat with one click from the toolbar, or press Ctrl+Shift+L. Anyone with access to MTI Brain can open it directly.

entries.title: Extended slash commands
entries.body: New commands in the composer: /speak reads the last response aloud, /export saves the conversation to PDF, /tone switches response style, /rows changes max result rows - all without leaving the keyboard.

entries.title: More keyboard shortcuts
entries.body: Ctrl+Shift+V to toggle voice input, Ctrl+Shift+E to export PDF, Ctrl+Shift+L to copy share link, Ctrl+R to retry the last response.

entries.title: High contrast mode
entries.body: New accessibility option in Settings → Appearance. Boosts text and border contrast to WCAG AAA levels for users who need higher visual clarity.

entries.title: Dialogs close instantly on save
entries.body: Edit, rename, and create dialogs now dismiss the moment you click Save - no waiting for the server. Changes apply optimistically and roll back silently if something goes wrong.

entries.title: New chat navigates immediately
entries.body: Submitting a new question from the home screen navigates to the chat page at once. The thread is created in the background while you can already see the conversation forming.

entries.title: Page transitions
entries.body: Navigating between pages now fades in with a subtle motion. Automatically disabled when your OS has reduce-motion enabled.

entries.title: Meaningful error feedback
entries.body: Failed saves, renames, deletes, and moves now surface a specific toast message with a prompt to retry - rather than silently reverting with no explanation.

entries.title: Session expiry on bookmarked links
entries.body: Visiting a saved URL after your 8-hour session expires now redirects cleanly to login instead of showing a raw error message.

entries.title: Chat not found redirect
entries.body: Opening a link to a deleted or inaccessible conversation now shows a brief toast and redirects to the home screen, rather than a blank or broken page.
